about_lead: OpenSoft runs open-source CRM and ERP systems for Hungarian small and medium-sized businesses.
about_p1: We select, install and run the open-source system that suits the way you work. The servers, the updates and the backups are handled by us.
about_p2: There are no per-user licence fees and no lock-in to a single vendor. Your data sits in a standard database and can be exported at any time.
about_p3: We start with a demo, then set up a trial environment with your own data. Only after that do you decide on the rollout.
contact_lead: Do you have a question? Write to us or call us and we will reply within one working day.
contact_cta: Or request a free demo instead
gdpr_lead: How we support your GDPR compliance as the operator of your system.
gdpr_p1: For the customer data stored in your system you are the controller, and we act as a processor. This is set out in a written data processing agreement (DPA).
gdpr_p2: We run your system and its backups in a data centre within the European Union; the exact location is set out in the contract. This website itself is served by an external hosting provider – we explain this on the Privacy page.
gdpr_p3: The open-source systems use a standard, exportable database, so requests for access, rectification and erasure can be fulfilled.
gdpr_p4: In the event of a breach we notify you without delay, so that you can meet the 72-hour notification deadline.
privacy_lead: What we process on this website.
privacy_p1: OpenSoft – the full company name, registered office, company registration number and data protection contact go here.
privacy_p2: Only what you provide in the demo request form: first name, last name, company name, mobile number and email address, together with the system you selected, the language of the page, the time of submission and the address of the page you submitted it from. Two technical fields are also sent to filter out spam; these are not stored.
privacy_p3: Solely to contact you about the demo you requested. The data is entered into our customer management system.
privacy_p4: This page does not use cookies and contains no tracking script. The only thing we store in your browser is the code of the language you selected.
privacy_p5: You may request a copy of your data, its rectification or its erasure at any time at the email address below.
doc_lang_en: This document is available in English.
doc_lang_hu: This document is available in Hungarian.
privacy_p6: The website itself is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States), which necessarily sees visitors' IP addresses in order to deliver the pages and handles its own logs as a separate controller. The data you enter in the form, however, goes directly to our own server in the EU: it does not pass through GitHub's systems.
